segments.contextBefore: Make your app’s text translatable by leveraging the localization APIs in the Foundation framework.
segments.contextAfter: Before the system can translate your app’s text, you need to prepare your app’s strings for translation by creating localizable versions of these strings using the `String(localized:)` and `AttributedString(localized:)` APIs found in the Foundation framework.

Text("Songs", bundle: Bundle(for: (BirdSongs.self))) // Localizable string within a framework for a `LocalizedStringResource`. LocalizedStringResource("Songs", bundle: .forClass(BirdSongs.self), comment: "Headline above the name of the song currently playing.") ```
segments.contextBefore: Use that `Bundle` to look up the localizable string.
